visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back and wispy bangs stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She wears a simple black top and holds a smartphone in her left hand to record her reflection in a large mirror. Her facial expression is serene and she looks directly into the camera lens within the reflection, showing a slight, confident smile. (2) She raises a large, light-green tumbler with a straw using her right hand and takes a deliberate sip. As she does this, large rectangular text boxes with white backgrounds and black Traditional Chinese characters appear as overlays, centered around her upper body. The background remains a consistent white wall with a partial view of a door frame. (3) She lowers the tumbler slightly while maintaining her pose and smile. More text content populates the lower half of the frame, organized into two distinct columns comparing '20s' and '30s' life stages. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting her facial features without harsh shadows.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 2025第一問. [Subtitle]: 妳 20's 和 30's 有什麼不同顯著生活習慣? 一路看著妳真的成熟 (也變漂亮很多). (2) [Slogan]: 先不論心智和人生經驗 先論從生活改變上. (3) [Variety]: 20s. [Subtitle]: 總忘了吃飯、天亮說晚安 沒有週休二日的工作 沒有任何娛樂 幾乎沒在運動 很常生病、跑急診跑醫院 很把握每次出國機會 購物追求多樣出鏡不能重複. (4) [Variety]: 30s. [Subtitle]: 有另一半一起吃飯 工作上軌道 自媒體有團隊不用孤軍奮戰 懂的服用適合自己的保健品 旅遊以舒服、放鬆為主 懂的安排給自己的假日 購物可以以用10年以上為基準. (5) [Slogan]: 其實生活層面最大差別是 因為財物能力可以更照顧自己 重點更養身心靈.
